content.ascii:
[P] Canvas publication and diagram record storage
|
|-- DiagramStore
|   |-- diagrams: RevisionedDiagramService(DiagramRevisionStore)
|   `-- canvases / projectCatalogs: ProjectCatalogStore
|       `-- extends CanvasCatalogStore [M2 destination]
|           |-- load/save catalog; saveMappingDiagram
|           |-- saveProjection / saveProjectedTree / archiveRepresentation
|           |-- serialized command writes
|           `-- canvases/catalog.json
|
|-- Other parent-file owners
|   |-- MappingWorkspaceStore -> mapping-workspace.json
|   `-- DiagramChangeSessionStore
|       `-- mapping-change-sessions/<project>/<session>.json
|
|-- Shared DiagramService persistence boundary
|   |-- persistDiagramData(expanded value)
|   |   |-- diagram -> immutable diagram-record reference
|   |   |-- revision -> metadata + diagram-record reference
|   |   `-- history -> revision references + checkpoint binding tables
|   |       `-- parent snapshots retain diagramCheckpointId,
|   |           not diagramBindings or diagramRevisions
|   `-- restoreDiagramData(stored value)
|       |-- hydrate references; validate diagrams and histories
|       |-- deduplicate reads; return detached expanded values
|       `-- accept legacy embedded values
|
|-- DiagramRevisionStore implements DiagramRecordStore
|   |-- diagrams/diagram/<sha256>.json
|   |   `-- content + source context + jumps
|   |-- diagrams/revision/<sha256>.json
|   |   `-- revision identity / parent / nodeRefs / diagram reference
|   |-- diagrams/history/<sha256>.json
|   |   `-- revision-record references + checkpoint bindings
|   `-- validate kind/ID; verify hashes; temporary-file rename
|
|-- Publication ordering
|   |-- validate expanded input
|   |-- persist referenced records
|   `-- atomically replace parent catalog/workspace/session file
|       |-- dependency failure leaves previous parent unpublished
|       `-- interrupted writes may leave unreferenced records
|
|-- Catalog compatibility and conflicts
|   |-- prefer canvases/catalog.json
|   |-- absent -> read representations/catalog.json
|   |-- next save writes new format; legacy catalog remains untouched
|   |-- validate history matches supplied scene/edges
|   |-- reject changes to existing immutable diagram revision IDs
|   `-- advanced saved revision
|       |-- DiagramRevisionEditor.merge: changed bindings -> MERGE_REQUIRED
|       `-- otherwise -> CANVAS_CONFLICT; no automatic reconciliation
|
`-- Public boundaries
    |-- HTTP and explicit workspace exports remain expanded and portable
    |-- derived catalog ASCII/evidence and saved-scene strings remain
    |-- missing/corrupt referenced records are errors
    `-- no record garbage collection or history compaction

Record hashes are storage identities, distinct from diagram revision UUIDs.
Workspace autosave is not catalog publication or multi-workspace synchronization.
Shared catalogPersistence.ts helpers are a code-organization extraction.
